controls.title: Leavers - timely deactivation
controls.objective: At as_of, no enabled person account belongs to an employee whose end_date is strictly before as_of; end_date equal to or after as_of remains compliant and only accounts with enabled=true are in scope.
controls.test_procedure: Join GET /api/lifecycle/accounts to GET /api/hr/employees on employee_id and flag any account with type=person and enabled=true where end_date is not null and end_date < meta.as_of.
controls.expected: enabled=false where type=person and end_date < as_of
controls.risk: A former employee retains logical access after contract end and could access or alter information assets without authorization.
controls.recommendation: Disable the non-compliant accounts and enforce automatic deactivation on contract end date.
controls.cause: Leaver process failure or missing synchronization between the HR register and account provisioning.

controls.title: Account ownership
controls.objective: At as_of, every enabled person account has an employee_id present in the HR register, and every enabled service account has an owner_employee_id present in the HR register with status=active; person accounts present but with status=left are excluded from this rule.
controls.test_procedure: Join enabled accounts to HR employees and flag type=person with employee_id not found and type=service with owner_employee_id not found or with status=left.
controls.expected: employee_id in employees.employee_id for enabled person accounts; owner_employee_id in employees.employee_id with status=active for enabled service accounts
controls.risk: Orphan or ownerless active accounts cannot be attributed or reviewed and may be abused without detection.
controls.recommendation: Attach each orphan account to a known active responsible person or disable it.
controls.cause: Missing ownership control at account creation or unsynchronised HR departures for service account owners.

controls.title: Dormant person accounts
controls.objective: At as_of, no enabled person account has been inactive for more than 90 days measured as as_of minus last_login, or created if last_login is null, with exactly 90 days remaining compliant; service accounts are out of scope.
controls.test_procedure: For all accounts with type=person and enabled=true, compute days between as_of and last_login or created if null and flag those exceeding 90 days.
controls.expected: as_of minus (last_login or created if null) <= 90 where type=person and enabled=true
controls.risk: Unused accounts can be compromised and exploited without detection because no legitimate user monitors them.
controls.recommendation: Disable or recertify dormant accounts and enforce automatic deactivation after 90 days of inactivity.
controls.cause: Missing periodic review or automated deactivation for inactive accounts.

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.objective: At as_of, no enabled account simultaneously holds paiements.saisie and paiements.validation, nor credit.instruction and credit.decision.
controls.test_procedure: For all accounts with enabled=true, inspect entitlements and flag accounts containing both entitlements of either incompatible pair.
controls.expected: entitlements does not contain paiements.saisie + paiements.validation nor credit.instruction + credit.decision where enabled=true
controls.risk: A single user could initiate and approve the same payment or credit, enabling fraud or undetected error.
controls.recommendation: Remove one of the conflicting entitlements and enforce preventive segregation checks at provisioning.
controls.cause: Missing segregation-of-duties matrix enforcement in the entitlement assignment process.

controls.title: Movers - removal of prior rights
controls.objective: At as_of, no enabled account retains more than 30 days after transfer_date an entitlement whose department equals the holder's previous_department, with exactly 30 days remaining compliant; entitlements with department=null are out of scope.
controls.test_procedure: Join enabled accounts to HR employees and entitlement metadata and flag accounts where as_of minus transfer_date > 30 and entitlements includes a name whose department equals previous_department.
controls.expected: entitlements with department=previous_department removed where as_of minus transfer_date > 30 and enabled=true
controls.risk: Transferred employees accumulate excessive rights from successive departments, violating least privilege and enabling unauthorized actions.
controls.recommendation: Remove entitlements tied to the previous department for movers exceeding 30 days.
controls.cause: Mover process failure where prior department rights are never revoked after transfer.

controls.title: Privileged access review
controls.objective: At as_of, every enabled account holding at least one entitlement with privileged=true has a last_access_review within the last 365 days; null or older review is non-compliant.
controls.test_procedure: Join enabled accounts to entitlement metadata on privileged flag and flag accounts holding a privileged entitlement whose last_access_review is null or more than 365 days before as_of.
controls.expected: last_access_review within 365 days before as_of where enabled=true and entitlements includes privileged=true
controls.risk: Unreviewed privileged rights persist beyond business need and may grant excessive critical access without oversight.
controls.recommendation: Perform an access review for each privileged account and enforce annual recertification.
controls.cause: Missing or incomplete annual privileged access recertification process.
